entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: Uh, I found this on the car. There's[n]something written on it...

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: "You indulge in scamming others[n]with horrendous methods that[n]target minors exclusively."

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: "We have decided to make you confess[n]all your crimes with your own mouth."

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: "We will take your distorted[n]desires without fail."

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: I mean, if the higher-ups find out about[n]this...

entries.speaker: Kaneshiro
entries.en: Don't waste your time worrying about[n]this useless shit.

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: B-But it's... posted all around the city...

entries.speaker: Menacing Man
entries.en: People're talking about it online too...

entries.speaker: Kaneshiro
entries.en: All of you, bring me your earnings!

entries.speaker: Kaneshiro
entries.en: If you don't surpass your quota...[n]I'll kill you.

entries.speaker: Shadow Kaneshiro
entries.en: Phantom Thieves? Don't make me laugh.
